must: Keep academic actions legible and fast across desktop and mobile
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for every ambient or interface animation
avoid: Dense enterprise ERP tables as the dominant dashboard language
Decorative motion that blocks or delays an action

decisions: Use a cinematic academic-intelligence dashboard with a compact dark priority hero over a soft neutral workspace
Use deep indigo, ultraviolet and cool blue accents with warm status colors
Use mixed-weight bento metrics, restrained depth and fine grid texture for premium hierarchy
Motion is functional: route transitions, command search, focus sessions, notifications and the AI assistant
Keep the visual density compact enough for daily study planning while preserving generous card spacing
Adapt the supplied particle-drift language as a native canvas layer in the StudyOS priority hero, with no external runtime scripts
